source_title: Brickability Group Annual Report and Accounts 2021
availability_evidence: The issuer's 5 August 2021 preliminary-results announcement states that the financial information was approved by the Board on 4 August 2021 and derived from the audited statements; corresponding Companies House-filed accounts are hash-preserved locally.
observation: Revenue fell 3.2% to £181.1m and like-for-like revenue fell 13.2% as COVID-19 restrictions disrupted trading; adjusted EBITDA declined 10.1% to £17.5m. Gross profit nevertheless rose to £38.0m and gross margin improved to 21.0% from 20.1%. Bank borrowings reduced by £9.1m, facility headroom was £14.1m, and the business reported a strong recovery after the initial lockdown, an encouraging start to the new year and a strong order book.
already_announced_exclusion: COVID-19 operating adaptations, furlough support, cost-control actions, acquisitions, post-period acquisitions and the announced refinancing and equity raise were disclosed or completed before cutoff and are excluded from any future target event.
review_note: Material pandemic and revenue pressure plus lower EBITDA support an elevated pressure score. Improving margin, lower borrowings, recovery and a strong order book provide substantial contrary evidence; all identified interventions were already public.

source_title: Brickability Group Annual Report and Accounts 2023
availability_evidence: The issuer annual report states that the strategic report and financial statements were approved by the Board on 14 July 2023; issuer-served report bytes are hash-preserved locally.
observation: Despite a challenging macroeconomic backdrop, revenue increased to £681.1m from £520.2m, adjusted EBITDA rose to £51.5m from £39.5m and adjusted profit before tax rose to £44.6m from £34.7m. Gross profit increased to £112.9m from £86.8m while gross margin was broadly stable at 16.6% versus 16.7%. Cash generated from operations rose to £44.9m from £27.5m; year-end net debt was modest at £8.0m versus £0.4m net cash in the prior year. Every division delivered growth.
already_announced_exclusion: Acquisitions and integrations, management succession and all operational or financing actions disclosed or completed in the report before cutoff are excluded from any future target event.
review_note: Macro pressure and the movement from net cash to modest net debt warrant limited pressure scores. Strong revenue, profit and operating-cash growth across every division provide exceptionally strong contrary evidence, with no undisclosed restructuring signal identified.
